subject: [PATCH 08/10] mm/madvise: separate the PTL-held PTE scan

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch separates the PTE scan in the madvise function from its surrounding lock drops, allowing it to run entirely under the PTE lock. The scan is moved into a helper function that returns a locked and referenced split candidate or stops at the existing scheduling boundary. This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves the code's structure and efficiency.
